limitations: Analytic rectangle is a verification domain, not a new LCFS.

Independent ledgers establish discrete thermal/particle equation consistency, not whole-machine or experimental accuracy.
Numerical state-validity checks do not establish MHD stability, disruption prediction or facility operating safety.
Fine-grid quartic identity is cancellation-sensitive in double precision (about 9.20e-7 relative against the 1e-6 gate); endpoint construction and runtime are recorded.
